# Vendored: portraitgen

Copied from https://github.com/CounterClockTTRPG/portraitgen at commit 34c78ca (`src/` only), MIT licence.
`png-node.js` is omitted (it needs @resvg/resvg-js); portraits are rendered as SVG in the browser.
To update: copy `src/` again from a newer checkout and update the commit above.
